moments.title: Community Shield kicks off new football season
moments.blurb: The FA Community Shield, featuring Arsenal and Manchester City, will be played at Principality Stadium in Cardiff on Sunday, August 16th, marking the traditional curtain-raiser for the new English football season.

angles.name: Football is back
angles.copy: Football's back! The Community Shield lights up Cardiff next Sunday as Arsenal face Man City. Who's lifting the first silverware of the season?

angles.name: Cardiff hosts
angles.copy: Cardiff takes centre stage for the Community Shield! Principality Stadium hosts Arsenal v Man City next Sunday. Big game for the capital!

moments.title: Premier League 2026/27 season begins
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off on Friday, August 21st, with reigning champions Arsenal hosting newly promoted Coventry City.

angles.name: Season opener
angles.copy: The wait is almost over! The Premier League season kicks off on August 21st with Arsenal taking on Coventry City. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: New season excitement
angles.copy: Mark your calendars! The Premier League is just around the corner. Get ready for new signings, fresh rivalries, and all the drama of the opening weekend!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival wraps up
moments.blurb: The Boardmasters Festival, combining surfing, skateboarding, and music, is taking place in Newquay, Cornwall, from August 5th to 9th, 2026.

angles.name: Festival vibes
angles.copy: That's a wrap on Boardmasters Festival 2026! Who caught the waves and the tunes in Newquay this year?

angles.name: Cornwall highlight
angles.copy: Cornwall has been buzzing all week with Boardmasters! Incredible music, surf, and skate action down in Newquay. What were your highlights?

moments.title: Ariana Grande's O2 residency begins
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande kicks off her highly anticipated ten-night 'Eternal Sunshine Tour' residency at London's O2 Arena on Friday, August 15th.

angles.name: Ariana takes over The O2
angles.copy: Get ready, Arianators! Ariana Grande's epic ten-night residency at The O2 in London starts next Friday. Who's got tickets to the 'Eternal Sunshine Tour'?

angles.name: London is ready for Ari
angles.copy: London, are you ready for Ariana Grande? Her huge O2 residency kicks off next week! It's going to be an 'Eternal Sunshine' summer!

moments.title: The Weeknd plays Wembley Stadium
moments.blurb: The Weeknd brings his record-breaking 'After Hours Til Dawn Stadium Tour' to Wembley Stadium in London for five nights, starting August 14th.

angles.name: The Weeknd at Wembley
angles.copy: Abel Tesfaye takes over Wembley Stadium next week! The Weeknd's 'After Hours Til Dawn Tour' hits London for five massive nights. Get ready for an epic show!

angles.name: London's stadium superstar
angles.copy: Wembley is ready for The Weeknd! Five nights of hits and spectacle in London starting Thursday. Who's got their tickets?

moments.title: Roots Picnic makes UK debut
moments.blurb: The iconic Roots Picnic festival makes its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl, London, on August 8th and 9th, bringing a blend of music, culture, and community.

angles.name: Roots Picnic in London
angles.copy: The Roots Picnic is HERE! Making its international debut at Crystal Palace Bowl this weekend. London, get ready for a blend of music, culture, and community!

angles.name: Weekend festival vibes
angles.copy: Crystal Palace Bowl is alive with The Roots Picnic this weekend! Who's catching the acts and soaking up the vibes at this debut UK event?

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean make chart history
moments.blurb: Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the UK Number 1 spot for a record-breaking 20th week, extending its reign as the longest-running UK Number 1 single of all time.

angles.name: 20 weeks at Number 1!
angles.copy: History made! Sam Fender and Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is Number 1 for a staggering 20th week! The longest-running UK Number 1 ever. Incredible!

angles.name: Record breakers
angles.copy: Can anyone stop Sam Fender & Olivia Dean? 'Rein Me In' continues its record-breaking run at the top of the Official Singles Chart. What a track!

moments.title: Ariana Grande's 'petal' is UK Number 1 album
moments.blurb: Ariana Grande's new album 'petal' has debuted at Number 1 on the Official UK Albums Chart, with several tracks also entering the singles chart.

angles.name: Ariana's new album at #1
angles.copy: Congratulations to Ariana Grande! Her new album 'petal' has bloomed straight to Number 1 on the Official UK Albums Chart. Which tracks are your favourites?

angles.name: New music from Ari
angles.copy: Ariana Grande's 'petal' is officially the UK's Number 1 album! A fantastic achievement for the pop superstar.

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing 2026 launch date revealed
moments.blurb: The launch show for the 2026 series of 'Strictly Come Dancing' is set to be pre-recorded on September 9th and broadcast on BBC One on Saturday, September 19th, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly returns!
angles.copy: Dust off your dancing shoes! Strictly Come Dancing is back on September 19th! New hosts, new celebs, same glitterball dreams. Who are you excited to see?

angles.name: New Strictly hosts
angles.copy: Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe & Johannes Radebe are taking over Strictly hosting duties! The launch show airs Sept 19th on BBC One. Thoughts on the new line-up?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns with new judge
moments.blurb: The 17th season of 'The Great British Bake Off' is expected to begin in early September on Channel 4, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge, replacing Prue Leith.

angles.name: Bake Off is back!
angles.copy: Get ready for soggy bottoms and showstoppers! The Great British Bake Off returns in September with new judge Nigella Lawson. Who's excited?

angles.name: Nigella joins Bake Off
angles.copy: Huge news for Bake Off fans! Nigella Lawson is joining Paul Hollywood in the tent as a new judge. Can't wait for her critiques!

moments.title: Shawn Mendes turns 28
moments.blurb: Canadian singer-songwriter Shawn Mendes, known for hits like 'Stitches' and 'Treat You Better,' celebrates his 28th birthday today, August 8th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Shawn Mendes
angles.copy: Happy 28th Birthday to the incredible Shawn Mendes! What's your favourite track from the Canadian superstar?

angles.name: Celebrating Shawn
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 28th Birthday to Shawn Mendes today! Still can't believe how many hits he's given us already.

moments.title: Geri Halliwell-Horner turned 54
moments.blurb: Geri Halliwell-Horner, famously known as Ginger Spice from the Spice Girls, celebrated her 54th birthday on August 6th.

angles.name: Happy (belated) Birthday Ginger Spice
angles.copy: Girl Power! A belated Happy 54th Birthday to the iconic Geri Halliwell-Horner, who celebrated on August 6th. What's your favourite Spice Girls memory?

angles.name: Celebrating Geri
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy (belated) 54th birthday to our very own Ginger Spice, Geri Halliwell-Horner! Still got it!

moments.title: Mark Knopfler turns 77
moments.blurb: Mark Knopfler, the legendary guitarist and frontman of Dire Straits, celebrates his 77th birthday on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Knopfler
angles.copy: Happy 77th Birthday to the iconic Mark Knopfler on August 12th! What's your favourite Dire Straits track or solo gem?

angles.name: Dire Straits legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 77th to Mark Knopfler this Wednesday! A true guitar hero and songwriter legend.

moments.title: Sir Mix-A-Lot turns 63
moments.blurb: American rapper and producer Sir Mix-A-Lot, best known for his 1992 hit 'Baby Got Back,' celebrates his 63rd birthday on Wednesday, August 12th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Sir Mix-A-Lot
angles.copy: Oh my god, Becky, look at his birthday! Happy 63rd Birthday to Sir Mix-A-Lot on August 12th! What's your favourite 90s throwback from him?

angles.name: Celebrating a 90s icon
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 63rd Birthday to the one and only Sir Mix-A-Lot this Wednesday! Still got 'Baby Got Back' stuck in our heads.

moments.title: Joe Jonas turns 37
moments.blurb: Joe Jonas, member of the Jonas Brothers and frontman of DNCE, celebrates his 37th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Joe Jonas
angles.copy: Happy 37th Birthday to Joe Jonas on Saturday! From Jonas Brothers to DNCE, what's your favourite song featuring Joe?

angles.name: Celebrating Joe
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 37th to Joe Jonas this weekend! The pop icon has given us so many bops over the years.

moments.title: Jennifer Lawrence turns 36
moments.blurb: Oscar-winning actress Jennifer Lawrence, star of 'The Hunger Games' and 'Silver Linings Playbook,' celebrates her 36th birthday on Saturday, August 15th.

angles.name: Happy Birthday J-Law
angles.copy: Happy 36th Birthday to the amazing Jennifer Lawrence on August 15th! What's your favourite J-Law movie performance?

angles.name: Celebrating a star
angles.copy: Wishing a very Happy 36th Birthday to the brilliant Jennifer Lawrence this Saturday! An incredible talent.
